title: compact rollout journey mini-tour and policy editor mockups
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a compact, copy-light mini-tour and a set of high-fidelity policy editor mockups for rollouts and version pinning. Focus areas: a three-step onboarding micro-tour for first-time rollout creators, condensed canary / A-B split visualization, and an explicit fallback policy screen that explains behavior in overloaded regions. Deliverables include PNG/JPG screenshots for the docs quickstart, an illustrated microflow for the tour, and component-level specs for the console team to implement responsive variants.
acceptance_criteria: A compact 3-step mini-tour (Welcome, Configure Pin, Preview & Launch) with localized copy for EN/FR/DE
High-fidelity mockups for: canary rule editor, A-B split editor, pin-by-rule UI, and fallback policy modal
Accessible color contrast and tooltip content for each state (success, partial-failure, full-fallback)
Annotations and redlines for each artboard and a linked Figma file with component tokens
Screenshots exported at 1x and 2x for docs; filenames follow existing quickstart asset conventions
design_notes: Primary design constraint: keep the tour under 3 screens to limit friction in quickstart flows. Use the compact stepper pattern to surface progressive disclosure for advanced rollout options. For the policy editor, prefer a horizontal comparison bar for A-B that shows percentage and expected latency/cost delta rather than raw token counts. For fallback, the modal should visualize a sequence: primary model -> variant fallback -> region fallback -> degraded response banner. Minimize new visual metaphors; reuse existing console color tokens and iconography. Consider micro-animations on hover for the traffic slider to indicate commit preview. Include copy variations for novice vs. advanced mode.
screens_spec: Artboard sizes: desktop 1280x720, tablet 1024x600, mobile 360x780. Components: compact stepper, traffic slider with % input, model pin pill, fallback timeline with three nodes, and preview response CTA. Each artboard must include hotspot overlays for tooltips and keyboard-only focus states. Export slices named: compact-tour-step1.png, compact-tour-step2.png, compact-tour-step3.png, policy-canary.png, policy-ab.png, policy-fallback.png.
